in_marathi.name: Aindri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aindri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aindri is the Sanskrit name of the Hindu goddess of the moon. She is considered the embodiment of nurturing, fertility, and feminine power. Aindri is also believed to be the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
